description: Implementation of PID controller classes for firmware, including PID logic, state posting, and filtering mechanisms.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: Class implementing PID control logic with methods for calculation, resetting, and state reporting.

classes.name: PidCic
classes.description: Derived class implementing cascaded integrator-comb filtering for PID control.

methods.name: Pid::Pid
methods.description: Constructs a PID object, optionally initializing with a pid_s structure.

methods.name: Pid::initPidClass
methods.description: Initializes the PID class with a given pid_s structure.

methods.name: Pid::isSame
methods.description: Checks if the current PID parameters are the same as another.

methods.name: Pid::getValue
methods.description: Calculates the PID output based on target and input values.

methods.name: Pid::getRawValue
methods.description: Calculates raw PID output without clamping.

methods.name: Pid::updateFactors
methods.description: Updates the PID P, I, D factors.

methods.name: Pid::reset
methods.description: Resets internal PID state variables.

methods.name: Pid::getP
methods.description: Returns the proportional factor.

methods.name: Pid::getI
methods.description: Returns the integral factor.

methods.name: Pid::getPrevError
methods.description: Returns the previous error value.

methods.name: Pid::getIntegration
methods.description: Returns the current I-term value.

methods.name: Pid::getD
methods.description: Returns the D factor.

methods.name: Pid::getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value.

methods.name: Pid::setErrorAmplification
methods.description: Sets the error amplification coefficient.

methods.name: Pid::postState
methods.description: Posts current PID state to TunerStudio output channels.

methods.name: Pid::sleep
methods.description: Sleeps for the PID period duration.

methods.name: Pid::showPidStatus
methods.description: Logs the current PID settings and status.

methods.name: Pid::updateITerm
methods.description: Updates the I-term with a new value, limiting its range.

methods.name: PidCic::PidCic
methods.description: Constructor for PidCic, initializes cascaded filtering.

methods.name: PidCic::reset
methods.description: Resets the PidCic internal state and buffers.

methods.name: PidCic::getValue
methods.description: Returns the filtered PID value.

methods.name: PidCic::updateITerm
methods.description: Updates the I-term using cascaded integrator-comb filtering.
